routes.description: The NExtSEEK Chat Assistant lets you query the NExtSEEK biological sample repository using plain English. Under the hood it translates your questions into NExtSEEK REST API calls and Neo4j graph database queries, then summarizes the results for you. The repository holds biological samples, experimental data files, metadata records, and organizational structures (projects, investigations, studies) from across multiple research programs. You do not need to know any API syntax, Cypher, or SQL — just describe what you want.
routes.best_for: Requests supported by the NS capability authority: Sample Search; Graph Queries; Sample Lineage; Upload Statistics and Reporting; Follow-up Questions; Search Refinements; Entity and Catalog Information; System Capabilities Questions.
routes.not_for: Not intended for: Generate visualizations or charts.; Perform statistical analysis.; Explain external scientific concepts.; Answer questions about data outside NExtSEEK.; Compare groups analytically..

task_families.name: sample_search
task_families.description: Find samples by type, attribute, treatment, keyword, lab code or UID. No assay: assay lives on DERIVED_FROM and belongs to graph_traversal.
example_queries: Find me mice treated with NDMA.
Do we have any western blot data

task_families.name: sample_retrieve
task_families.description: Pull the full record for samples the user can already name.
example_queries: Retrieve D.SEQ-221031SHA-65-PUB and D.SEQ-221031SHA-67-PUB.
Look up these samples: D.SEQ-230512FOR-288-PUB, D.SEQ-230512FOR-289-PUB, D.SEQ-221031SHA-65-PUB, D.SEQ-221031SHA-67-PUB, NHP-220630FLY-5-PUB.

task_families.name: catalog_browse
task_families.description: List the platform's own objects: assays, projects, people, protocols, investigations.
example_queries: How many people are registered in NExtSEEK, and how many different scientists appear on the samples?
How many SOPs are on file, and are any of them test artifacts?

task_families.name: graph_traversal
task_families.description: Structural questions over the graph, including every assay and protocol traversal.
example_queries: Find sequencing data generated on a NextSeq instrument.
How many cell samples are in the Impact investigation?

task_families.name: lineage_tree
task_families.description: Trace what came from what, in either direction.
example_queries: Find me monkeys that have flow and sequencing data.
Find zebrafish with single-cell ATAC-seq data.

task_families.name: vocabulary_resolution
task_families.description: Turn the user's words into NExtSEEK codes before anything else runs.
example_queries: How many PBMC samples do we have?
I'm building an upload sheet for mouse samples — what attributes does that sample type need?

task_families.name: system_capability_question
task_families.description: What the system is, what it can do, what vocabulary exists.
example_queries: What can you do? List your capabilities.
What is a D.SEQ sample?

task_families.name: followup_over_results
task_families.description: Ask about results already returned, including aggregating an attribute over 'those'. Absorbs within-chat memory for both engines.
example_queries:
turn 1 (seed): Find the patient-visit samples whose Treatment1 is Acetaminophen.
turn 2 (recall): How many results was that again?

turn 1 (seed): Find the imaging datasets whose Type is Brightfield.
turn 2 (followup): Which lab did all of those come from?

task_families.name: search_refinement
task_families.description: Change one filter and re-run the previous search.
example_queries:
turn 1 (seed): Find samples from a 4 week study.
turn 2 (refine): Just the 4 week ones.

turn 1 (seed): Find NHP samples whose Origin is India.
turn 2 (refine): Show me the ones from China instead.

task_families.name: retrieval_path_selection
task_families.description: Which execution path inside the NExtSEEK engine a question takes.
example_queries:
turn 1 (open_wizard): Build me an nf-core RNA-seq samplesheet for D.SEQ-230512FOR-288-PUB.
turn 2 (interrupt): Actually, hang on — find me the mice treated with NDMA first.
Put together a summary of the samples IMPACT uploaded last year.

task_families.name: project_summary_report
task_families.description: How much data a project, lab or investigation holds. All four report modes.
example_queries: Summarise the CSBC investigation for me.
How many samples, protocols, and published datasets does the MetNet project have

task_families.name: submission_package
task_families.description: Build a repository deposit for a UID set. GEO, SRA and PRIDE only; nf-core is a pipeline concern.
example_queries: Build a PRIDE deposit for D.MSP-230522GRI-1-PUB and D.MSP-230522GRI-2-PUB.
Create a GEO deposit file for D.SEQ-241219BRY-5-PUB

task_families.name: pipeline_launch
task_families.description: Run an nf-core pipeline on the cluster for a resolved cohort, including producing its samplesheet.
example_queries: Build an nfcore samplesheet for these
Create an nf-core samplesheet for D.SEQ-240709KAM-4-PUB and D.SEQ-241219BRY-2-PUB

task_families.name: harmonization
task_families.description: Find near-duplicate attribute values, propose a canonical mapping, hand it to batch upload.
example_queries: How many samples list ImmPort as their repository, across every spelling?
How many tissue samples have Organ set to lung? Count both capitalisations and tell me what they are.

task_families.name: entity_write
task_families.description: Create, update or delete a record, or edit a sample type's attributes.
example_queries: Before we change anything — what attributes does the MUS sample type have today?

task_families.name: writes_unsupported
task_families.description: Refuse a write on the read-only engine, without over-refusing a deliverable.
example_queries: Export all metadata for NHP-220630FLY-1-PUB and its derived samples to Excel

task_families.name: cross_session_memory
task_families.description: What carries across sessions and containers, including the CC to NS asymmetry.
example_queries: What do you remember from my previous chat sessions?

turn 1 (ask): How many mass-spectrometry data samples are in the database?
turn 2 (recall): Remind me what that number was.

task_families.name: turn_delivery_and_trace
task_families.description: How a turn starts, streams, ends with a legible outcome, and is reconstructed after.
example_queries:
turn 1 (open_wizard): Build me an nf-core rnaseq samplesheet for the D.SEQ-240910LAU samples.
turn 2 (cancel): cancel
turn 3 (after_cancel): How many NHP samples are there?

task_families.name: cc_sandbox_contract
task_families.description: CC agent behaviour when a tool fails or a write is proposed. Stop-after-2, prohibitions, the L3 gate.
example_queries: Can you pull together the sequencing data for that study we talked about?

routes.description: Container Claude Code: full agentic environment with file I/O, code execution, and arbitrary plugins / skills (including the nextseek-batch-upload skill).
routes.best_for: Open-ended reasoning, file I/O, code, multi-tool workflows, and building/validating NExtSEEK batch-upload create/update sheets.
routes.not_for: Pure deterministic NExtSEEK lookups that the NS route handles without container tools; caller identity, session, or access-scope questions the NS route already resolves; catalog bookkeeping the NS route answers without shell access; and nf-core pipeline build/launch work that belongs on the NS route. Having a shell is not a reason to route here when NExtSEEK already holds the answer.
